subject.title: fix(gateway): OAuth-only xAI tools are missing from CLI-backend sessions

question: After the proof script is corrected, should maintainers accept this PR as the canonical branch for the OAuth-only xAI loopback tool fix, or choose a sibling PR instead?
rationale: The production fix shape is narrow, but the change deliberately expands credential-backed tool availability on the loopback MCP surface and there are competing open PRs for the same linked bug.

options.title: Require proof repair first
options.body: Fix or replace the proof script so it uses a real plugin registry, then choose the canonical PR with valid proof.

options.title: Land a sibling instead
options.body: Select another proof-positive sibling PR as canonical if maintainers prefer its smaller or cleaner implementation.

options.title: Accept maintainer-run proof
options.body: A maintainer can independently run live OAuth/CLI proof and accept the auth-boundary tradeoff despite the contributor proof defect.

recommendation.title: Require proof repair first
recommendation.body: Fix or replace the proof script so it uses a real plugin registry, then choose the canonical PR with valid proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history on the Claude CLI loopback MCP bridge and are the best available owner for the canonical-branch and loopback auth-boundary choice.
